credits.title: Flow
credits.overview: Grieving an unexpected loss, a woman searches for solace and reckons with surrender to a future she could never have anticipated

credits.title: Two Ugly People
credits.overview: Two strangers meet by chance in a highway-side motel but as their stay goes on, we begin to wonder if their meeting was by chance at all.

credits.title: A House
credits.overview: A young woman must face the trauma of her childhood while spending an evening alone with her terminally ill father.

credits.title: Indigo Lake
credits.overview: An artist is hired by a nightclub owner to paint a portrait of his beautiful wife. When the artist and wife fall in love, the nightclub owner's jealousy erupts in violence. To save themselves, the lovers are driven to attempt his murder.

credits.title: Face to Face
credits.overview: Face to Face is adapted from David Williamson's play of the same name which is in turn based on the transcripts from real conflict resolution sessions. credits.title: Matching Jack
credits.overview: A woman struggles with her son's illness and her husband's infidelity, but, after a chance encounter with an Irish sailor and his son, her life is turned upside down in a love story that defies explanation and breaks all the rules.

credits.title: Erskineville Kings
credits.overview: Barky, 25, lost soul, left home two years ago to escape his abusive father leaving behind everything in the world that was important to him; now that his father's dead, he thinks it's safe to come home.
